title: # REQUIRED. The class name as a seeker should read it.
country: REQUIRED. Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. DE.
city: Required for offline. Town or city. Required for offline classes; used to place online ones.
address: Required for offline. Street address, without the city or country.
state: State, province or region. Improves the address match where a city name repeats.
latitude: Decimal degrees. Given with longitude, this becomes the map point.
longitude: Decimal degrees. Given with latitude, this becomes the map point.
venueName: The building or hall, where it has a name a seeker would look for.
room: Room or floor within the venue.
onlineUrl: Required for online. Meeting link. Required for online classes.
description: Plain text. Line breaks become paragraphs.
contactName: Published as entered — the name a seeker sees.
contactPhone: Published as entered. Include the country code.
languages: Comma-separated locale codes, e.g. "de,en". Blank uses the batch default.
managerName: The coordinator's name. Used only when managerEmail names a new account.
managerEmail: The coordinator who vouches for this class. Blank publishes it unverified.
timezone: IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Blank derives it from the location.
scheduleType: REQUIRED. one-off, weekly, monthly or inactive.
date: YYYY-MM-DD. Required unless the class is inactive: the date for one-off, the first occurrence for weekly and monthly.
startTime: HH:MM, 24-hour. Required unless scheduleType is inactive.
weekdays: Comma-separated two-letter codes for a weekly class that meets more than once a week, e.g. "MO,TH". Blank uses the weekday of the date. List all seven for a daily class.
interval: Repeat every N weeks or months. Blank means every one.
untilDate: YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means the class repeats indefinitely.
